units.source_text: 此时，他又记起那五节小姐来。

en.t: At this moment, he remembered the young lady of the Gosechi dance again.

units.source_text: 他始终不忘记这个人，总想再见一面。

en.t: He had never forgotten her, and he always longed to see her once more.

units.source_text: 然而相见机会难得，又不能偷偷地去访。

en.t: But chances to meet were hard to come by, and he could not secretly go to visit her.

units.source_text: 那女的也始终不忘记源氏公子。

en.t: That woman, too, had never forgotten Prince Genji.

units.source_text: 父母屡次劝她结婚，她却绝不动心。

en.t: Her parents repeatedly urged her to marry, but she was not moved at all.

units.source_text: 源氏公子想建造几座舒适的邸宅，把五节之类的人邀集过来，如果要教养明石那个前程远大的女儿，可请这些人当保姆。

en.t: Prince Genji thought of building several comfortable residences and inviting women such as the Gosechi lady to live there; if Akashi's promising daughter was to be brought up, he could ask these women to serve as her nurses.

units.source_text: 他那东院的建筑，比二条院更加讲究，全是现代风格。

en.t: The buildings of his Eastern Residence were even more carefully designed than those at Nijo, and all were in a modern style.

units.source_text: 他选定几个熟识的国守，叫他们分担这些建筑工事，要克日完成。

en.t: He selected several provincial governors he knew well, had them divide up the construction work, and ordered it completed by the appointed date.
